items.title: Rechtsextremistische Chatgruppe "Terror 18" - Drei Teenager unter Terrorverdacht festgenommen - und mit Auflagen wieder freigekommen
items.teaser: Nach der Festnahme von drei mutmaßlichen Mitgliedern einer rechtsextremistischen Terrorgruppe sind die drei Beschuldigten wieder auf freiem Fuß. Die Haftbefehle wurden unter Auflagen außer Vollzug gesetzt, wie die Bundesanwaltschaft mitteilte.

items.title: Forget movie beams cutting off wings. Ukraine’s laser just stares at one spot on drones until its electronics fry, expert says
items.teaser: Ukraine's new laser air defense runs on electricity, not missiles. It brings down a jet-powered Geran by overheating the drone from the inside.

items.title: War update: 151 clashes along the front line; 40 Russian troops killed on Pokrovsk axis
items.teaser: On November 25, Ukrainian forces reported 151 combat engagements along the front line, including 18 Russian attacks repelled in the Pokrovsk sector.

items.title: Russia slams Kyiv in ballistic missile attack, hits shopping center, injures 3
items.teaser: Russia launched a massive ballistic missile attack against Ukraine late on Nov. 25, striking a shopping center in Kyiv and injuring three people, according to authorities.

items.title: Kyiv under ballistic missile attack. Strike hits shopping mall
items.teaser: Explosions were heard in Kyiv during an air raid alert as Russian forces launched a ballistic missile attack on the capital.

items.title: Ukrainian attacks drive Russian oil refining to 20-year low – Bloomberg
items.teaser: Russia’s oil refining volumes have fallen to their lowest level in more than two decades as Ukrainian forces intensify their campaign of strikes against Russian refineries.

items.title: Cabinet eases approval of new Ukrainian drones, EW systems and explosives for military use
items.teaser: The government has simplified the official approval process for new Ukrainian-made drones, electronic warfare (EW) systems and explosives for use by the Armed Forces of Ukraine.

items.title: Former European leaders urge EU to make long-term commitments to Ukraine
items.teaser: More than 100 influential figures have joined members of the European Young Leaders (EYL40) network in calling on EU countries to make long-term financial and political commitments to support Ukraine at this week’s European Council meeting.

items.title: Ukrainisches Lasersystem Blysk schießt weltweit erstmals russische Drohne „Geran“ ab
items.teaser: Das ukrainische Laser-Luftverteidigungssystem Blysk der Firma Carmine Sky hat erstmals die russische Kampfdrohne „Geran“ abgeschossen.

items.title: “A true family heirloom”: Magyar shows gift from Zelensky
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar has described a gift he received from Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky during his visit to Uzhhorod as a “true family heirloom.”

items.title: War is not Ukraine’s toughest challenge, expert says
items.teaser: In addition to the war, Ukraine faces major challenges related to demographics, the modernization of social ethics, changes to its system of governance, and instability in international partnerships.

items.title: Norwegen stellt dem ukrainischen Energieunterstützungsfonds zusätzliche 46,3 Mio. Euro bereit
items.teaser: Norwegen hat dem Energiefonds für die Ukraine weitere 46,3 Millionen Euro zugeteilt.

items.title: Zelensky: No word yet from US on accelerating air defense missile deliveries
items.teaser: The United States has yet to provide Ukraine with any positive signals regarding the acceleration of air defense missile deliveries.

items.title: Government extends deadline for businesses to provide shelters during “yellow” air alerts to June 2027
items.teaser: The government has extended the transitional period for businesses to meet requirements for protecting employees and visitors during yellow-level air alerts through June 4, 2027.

items.title: Russian aircraft and vessels carrying military cargo legitimate targets for Ukraine – Zelensky
items.teaser: Russian aircraft, warships, and vessels transporting Russian weapons are legitimate targets for Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian combat robot gets stuck in mud near Russian border. Two locals on bikes stop, grab rope, and haul it back to work
items.teaser: Ukraine's ground robots handle the front's riskiest runs, 31,398 in October alone.

items.title: Border guards foil Russian mechanized assault in northern Kharkiv Region
items.teaser: Border guards from the Forpost Brigade repelled a Russian mechanized assault north of Vovchanski Khutory in the Kharkiv region.

items.title: Rutte believes Trump is putting Putin to the test
items.teaser: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte defended Donald Trump's approach to Vladimir Putin ahead of their Mar-a-Lago meeting, saying pressure must continue.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: Poland plans no-fly zone near Ukraine border, asks NATO to intercept Russian missiles over Ukraine
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 25: Poland plans no-fly zone near Ukraine border, asks NATO to intercept Russian missiles over Ukraine Ukraine strikes 2 Russian oil refineries in massive attack on Samara Oblast, General Staff confirms SBU detains Russian GRU agent accused of plotting to kill Ukrainian special forces commander

items.title: Peter Magyar meets Volodymyr Zelenskyy: Hungary and Ukraine make a fresh start after the icy relations of the Viktor Orban era
items.teaser: After years of frosty and hostile relations under Hungary's Kremlin-friendly former PM Viktor Orban, his successor, Peter Magyar, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy seek to reset their countries' ties.

items.title: HUR-Operation mit großer Reichweite: Einzigartiger russischer Luft- und Raumfahrtaufklärungskomplex zerstört
items.teaser: Infolge einer Operation deep strike der Hauptverwaltung für Militärnachrichtendienst (HUR) des Verteidigungsministeriums der Ukraine wurde der russische Luft- und Raumfahrtaufklärungskomplex zerstört.

items.title: Expert explains why both far right and far left gaining popularity in Europe
items.teaser: Radical political forces are gaining ground across Europe on both the right and left of the ideological spectrum. One reason for the growing appeal of isolationism and nationalism is that people feel increasingly vulnerable amid globalization and intensifying competition.

items.title: Schwerste Straftaten geplant: Razzia bei rechtsextremer Terrorgruppe: Jugendliche kommen vorläufig frei
items.teaser: Drei 14- bis 15-Jährige werden am Morgen wegen des Vorwurfs der Mitgliedschaft in einer terroristischen Vereinigung festgenommen. Sie sollen unter anderem die gezielte Tötung von ausländischen Menschen geplant haben. Nun sind zwei von ihnen unter Auflagen wieder auf freiem Fuß.

items.title: Barvinivka in Zaporizhzhia region remains under Ukrainian control
items.teaser: Russian claims that their forces have captured the village of Barvinivka in the Zaporizhzhia region are false.

items.title: Ukrainian journalists outnumbered 30 to 1 by Russian propagandists during Oleshky evacuation, reporter says
items.teaser: According to Romakhlo, the Russian side attempted to portray Ukraine as responsible for the humanitarian crisis in Oleshky.

items.title: Ukraine-Hilfe polarisiert die Generaldebatte im Bundestag
items.teaser: Im Bundestag wurde über den Haushalt 2027 debattiert. Darin auch enthalten: rund zwölf Milliarden Euro Ukraine-Hilfe. Für die AfD ist das eine Veruntreuung von Steuergeldern, für Kanzler Merz die Verteidigung "unserer Freiheit". Von Nicole Markwald.

items.title: Ukraine's Blysk laser makes world first, shooting down Russian jet-powered drone
items.teaser: Ukraine's Blysk laser air defense system, developed by Carmine Sky, has shot down a Russian jet-powered Geran drone for the first time.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte vereiteln russischen Durchbruchsversuch bei Dobropillja
items.teaser: Soldaten der 25. selbständigen Luftlandebrigade „Sitscheslaw“ haben in Zusammenarbeit mit benachbarten Einheiten der ukrainischen Streitkräfte einen Durchbruchsversuch russischer Angreifer im Raum des Dorfes Dobropillja im Landkreis Pokrowsk der Region Donezk vereitelt.

items.title: "Vicious circle": Ukraine says situation around Starshield remains unresolved
items.teaser: Ukrainian diplomat Denys Sienik said restrictions on Starshield in Ukraine remain unresolved, calling it a "vicious circle" putting civilians at risk.

items.title: Russians' tactics remain unchanged: they strike power lines and substations, we repair them – Zelenskyy
items.teaser: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on 25 November that Russia's tactics remain unchanged, targeting power lines and substations to disrupt electricity transmission.

items.title: Six photos from Ukraine included in TIME's Top 100 Photos of 2026
items.teaser: Six photographs from Ukraine have been included in the American magazine TIME's annual selection of the 100 most outstanding images of the year, TIME's Top 100 Photos of 2026.

items.title: Ukrainian combat laser intercepts Russian jet-powered drone for first time
items.teaser: So far, persistent cloud cover and fog over Kyiv had reportedly prevented the system from engaging Russian drones effectively.

items.title: Hungarian PM Magyar says Zelenskyy gave him gift honouring his great-grandfather
items.teaser: Hungarian PM Péter Magyar said Volodymyr Zelenskyy gifted him a 1942 newspaper mentioning his great-grandfather during his visit to Zakarpattia.

items.title: Zelensky waiting for US to set date for next round of peace talks
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said he was waiting for the United States to set a date for the next meeting of the negotiating teams, which should now be quadrilateral with Europe also taking part.

items.title: Ukraine's next election
items.teaser: A rushed election could also hand Moscow something it has so far failed to achieve on the battlefield: a Ukrainian leadership whose legitimacy can be systematically challenged.

items.title: Präsident Selenskyj trifft den estnischen Außenminister Magrus Tsahkna
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte heute nach dem Treffen mit dem estnischen Außenminister Margus Tsahkna auf Facebook, er erwarte von den USA die Bekanntgabe eines Termins für ein neues Treffen der Verhandlungsteams. Dieses Treffen solle im Vierer-Format unter Beteiligung Europas stattfinden.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian airstrike on Sloviansk rises to 10, one person killed
items.teaser: The number of people injured in a Russian airstrike on Sloviansk has risen to 10, with two people in critical condition.

items.title: Value of frozen Russian assets in Switzerland rises to over US$10bn
items.teaser: The value of Russian assets frozen in Switzerland rose by 15% to CHF 8.5 billion (US$10.2 billion) compared with April 2025, Bloomberg reported.

items.title: Black Sea port blockade could cost Ukraine $9.8 billion in 2027, study says
items.teaser: A year-long blockade of Ukraine's three major Black Sea ports could reduce the country's gross domestic product (GDP) by 4.1%, according to an economic assessment by the Center for Transport Strategies (CFTS).

items.title: AI expands Russia's ability to conduct global disinformation campaigns – expert
items.teaser: Russia is actively using artificial intelligence and other advanced technologies to expand the geographical reach of its disinformation campaigns.

items.title: Estonia deports Russian national over suspected ties to Russian intelligence
items.teaser: Anton Zuyev was deported on Nov. 24 at the recommendation of KAPO to prevent and counter potential threats to Estonia's national security, the agency said.

items.title: Anschlagsplan? Jugendliche unter Terrorverdacht festgenommen
items.teaser: Schon wieder stehen Minderjährige im Verdacht, Gewalttaten gegen Ausländer und politische Gegner geplant zu haben.

items.title: Russian drone attacks car in Kharkiv Oblast, killing two
items.teaser: A Russian drone struck a civilian car in Kharkiv Oblast's Zolochiv hromada on 25 November, killing two people, likely a local couple, Syniehubov said.

items.title: European Parliament approves 2027 EU budget, allocating €650 mln to service Ukraine Loan
items.teaser: On Wednesday, Members of the European Parliament (MEPs) gave final approval to the European Union's annual budget for 2027.

items.title: Ukraine and Hungary to hold first meeting of minority rights commission in early 2027
items.teaser: Ukraine and Hungary will co-chair a commission on national minority rights, with its first meeting planned for early 2027, Hungarian PM Anita Orbán has said.

items.title: Russischer Luftangriff auf Slowjansk: Zahl der Verletzten steigt auf zehn, ein Toter
items.teaser: Die Zahl der Verletzten in der Stadt Slowjansk infolge des russischen Luftangriffs ist auf zehn gestiegen, zwei Personen sind in schwerem Zustand, teilte der Leiter der Militärbehörde von Slowjansk, Wadym Ljach, auf Facebook mit.

items.title: Dnipro sets up additional emergency assistance points amid power supply problems
items.teaser: Emergency responders have set up additional assistance points for residents of Dnipro amid the difficult electricity supply situation in the city.

items.title: Poland plans no-fly zone near Ukraine border, asks NATO to intercept Russian missiles over Ukraine
items.teaser: The proposals come amid growing concerns over Russian aerial incursions into NATO territory, following a series of incidents involving Russian missiles and drones entering Polish airspace during attacks on Ukraine on Nov. 23 and 24.

items.title: Himera raises $5 million to expand military communications business
items.teaser: "This investment allows us to advance technologies that help Ukrainian defenders carry out their missions more effectively," said Misha Rudominski, Himera's co-founder and CEO.

items.title: Ground robot joins Ukraine’s hunt for Russia’s jet Shaheds, a third of which evaded interception in October. Brigade says it downed one
items.teaser: The shootdown came on the same day Ukraine's top military command met over how to stop these drones.

items.title: Ukrainian firm Carmine Sky builds a laser to guard critical infrastructure. Its Blysk downs Russia’s jet-powered Geran in world’s first kill
items.teaser: The laser guards a critical infrastructure site, and its maker is still testing it before any serial production.

items.title: Ukraine shoots down Russian jet-powered Geran drone with combat laser for first time – video
items.teaser: Ukraine has shot down a Russian jet-powered Geran drone with a Blysk combat laser for the first time while defending critical infrastructure, an expert has reported.

items.title: Russian army attacks sawmill in Chernihiv region, three injured
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a sawmill in the Chernihiv district, injuring three men.

items.title: Finland, Norway pledge nearly $60 million to support Ukraine's energy sector repairs
items.teaser: The money will be used to buy equipment needed to repair energy facilities damaged by Russian attacks across Ukraine.

items.title: Sawmill catches fire in Chernihiv Oblast after Russian attack, three men injured
items.teaser: Three men were injured after a Russian attack sparked a fire at a sawmill in the Chernihiv district on 25 November, Ukraine's emergency service reported.

items.title: Parliament backs Ukraine's joining management committee of special tribunal on Russian aggression
items.teaser: Upon joining the committee, Ukraine will have a say in setting the tribunal's policies, approving its budget, and addressing administrative matters.

items.title: Head of Zelenskyy's office says prisoner swap could take place in late November or early December
items.teaser: Zelenskyy’s chief of staff Kyrylo Budanov says the first prisoners of war could be brought back in late November or early December in an exchange involving more than 1,000 people.

items.title: Estnischer Außenminister: 650.000 russische Touristen reisten letztes Jahr in die EU ein – das ist nicht normal
items.teaser: Letztes Jahr reisten 650.000 russische Touristen in den Schengen-Raum ein. Angesichts der terroristischen Akte und Sabotageakte Russlands in europäischen Ländern sei das nicht normal, erklärte heute der estnische Außenminister Magrus Tsahkna auf einer Pressekonferenz in Kyjiw.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia, sparking fire at transport company, injuring five
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked the Kosmichnyi district of Zaporizhzhia. A fire broke out at a motor transport company, and private houses were damaged. Five people were injured.

items.title: Russians attack energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast again
items.teaser: Another Russian attack on Dnipropetrovsk Oblast's energy infrastructure left parts of Dnipro and four districts without power on 25 November, DTEK reported.

items.title: Ukrainian border guards repel Russian mechanised assault in northern Kharkiv Oblast – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian border guards have repelled a mechanised assault near Vovchanski Khutory, destroying a PTS-2 amphibious transporter, two infantry fighting vehicles and two quad bikes.

items.title: Poland could have intercepted Russian missiles, drones over Ukraine, but legal changes needed – ex-defense minister
items.teaser: Poland could have considered shooting down Russian missiles and drones over Ukrainian territory if they are heading toward Polish airspace. However, this would require resolving legal issues and establishing coordination with the Ukrainian side.

items.title: Poland says NATO refuses to shoot down drones over Ukraine due to "numerous complications"
items.teaser: Polish Deputy Defence Minister Cezary Tomczyk said NATO does not support shooting down Russian drones over Ukraine as it would create numerous complications.

items.title: Russia changes tactics against Ukraine’s grid to drag out repairs. Cluster warheads often strike switches and relays across substations, Ukrenergo says
items.teaser: Ukraine has protected its big autotransformers fairly well, so Russia goes after the secondary equipment around them, and replacements take a long time to arrive.

items.title: How Ukraine fought from inside Russian positions in Operation Vivaldi
items.teaser: The Kyiv Independent’s Asami Terajima and Nick Allard speak with commanders involved in Operation Vivaldi about how Ukrainian forces prepared and carried out the counteroffensive.

items.title: Ukrainian forces thwart Russian attempt to break through near Dobropillia
items.teaser: Fighters from the 25th Airborne Brigade, in coordination with other Ukrainian Armed Forces units, thwarted an attempt by Russian forces to break through near the settlement of Dobropillia in the Pokrovsk district, Donetsk region.

items.title: Footage shows two Rosneft refineries on fire hours after Putin called retaliation “inevitable”
items.teaser: Ukraine's military reportedly paused its refinery campaign in mid-October, but a Russian Telegram channel counted 12 refineries attacked in the three weeks before the Samara strikes.

items.title: Ukraine: Poland to set up no-fly zone near Ukraine border
items.teaser: Poland urged NATO allies to be vigilant at their borders after repeated Russian airspace incursions. Allies have also offered different opinions on Kyiv attacking Russian ships in Libya. Follow DW for the latest.

items.title: IIHF to appeal ruling allowing Russia's return to international hockey in Swiss court
items.teaser: "The decision (to appeal to the Swiss Federal Tribunal) is based on concerns around the independence of the impartiality of two of the three arbitrators on the CAS panel, especially following information that has recently come to light regarding potential links between the two arbitrators and Russia" the IIHF said in a

items.title: Ungarn-Ukraine: Peter Magyar und Wolodymyr Selenskyj wagen Neustart
items.teaser: Lange vergiftete Viktor Orbans prorussischer Kurs Ungarns Verhältnis zur Ukraine. Nun schaffen Premier Magyar und Präsident Selenskyj bei einem Treffen eine neue Vertrauensbasis - und vereinbaren konkrete Schritte.

items.title: Ukrainian forces thwart Russian assault south of Dobropillia – video
items.teaser: 25th Sicheslav Airborne Brigade has reported that Russian forces attempting to advance south of Dobropillia under cover of strong winds were stopped after FPV drone strikes and a minefield disabled their armoured vehicles.

items.title: 5 Russian aircraft hit at airfield in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, General Staff says
items.teaser: Preliminary reports indicate that the attack hit three MiG-31 fighter jets and two Su-34 aircraft, according to Ukraine's General Staff.

items.title: Six injured, including child, in Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia – photos
items.teaser: Six people, including a child, have been injured in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia's Kosmichnyi district. Around 10 houses, a warehouse and cars have been damaged.

items.title: Sybiha outlines three priorities for Ukraine Recovery Conference in Tallinn
items.teaser: The main priorities of the international Ukraine Recovery Conference, to be held in Tallinn in late January, will be supporting Ukraine's energy and transport sectors, securing funding and equipment, and developing mechanisms to insure against war risks.

items.title: Self-proclaimed Belarusian president denies that he knew Russian forces would advance on Kyiv from Belarus in 2022
items.teaser: In an interview with French magazine Le Point, self-proclaimed Belarusian president Alexander Lukashenko has denied knowing in 2022 that Russian troops stationed in Belarus would launch an offensive on Kyiv.

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte greifen Flugplatz Sawaslejka an: Fünf Flugzeuge, mit denen Russland die Ukraine attackiert, getroffen
items.teaser: Die ukrainischen Verteidigungskräfte haben den russischen Flugplatz Sawaslejka angegriffen, auf dem MiG-31K – Träger der Raketen Kinschal – stationiert sind.

items.title: Russian drone strikes energy facility in Poltava region, four injured
items.teaser: Four people were injured after a Russian drone struck an energy facility in the Poltava district.

items.title: Three injured in Russian drone strike on energy facility in Poltava Oblast
items.teaser: A Russian drone hit an energy facility in the Poltava district, injuring three people. An explosion was heard in Poltava shortly after air defence systems were reported operating.

items.title: Ukraine ready to accelerate implementation of agreements on rights of Hungarian minority – Sybiha
items.teaser: Ukraine is ready to accelerate the implementation of agreements on ensuring the linguistic, cultural and educational rights of the Hungarian national minority, as the necessary legal framework is already in place.

items.title: Russia cuts healthcare while the army’s budget soars. Defense gets $209 billion in 2027, 35% of the federal budget
items.teaser: The government can still add defense money during the year without asking parliament, an exiled Russian economist and former deputy finance minister said.

items.title: Poland plans to establish a no-fly zone near its border with Ukraine
items.teaser: Deputy Defence Minister Cezary Tomczyk has said Poland is preparing a decree to create a no-fly zone along its border with Ukraine at the turn of the year to help pilots identify and intercept incoming aerial threats.

items.title: In This Issue
items.teaser: Opening the Articles section, Jaye Ellis argues that civil liability law has been overlooked as an important element of holding international corporations to account. For Ellis, the reasonable person standard can bridge different normative orders and overcome common obstacles faced by plaintiffs. In the next article, T

items.title: Ex-soldier recruited by Russia’s GRU was caught meters from a bomb meant for Ukrainian special forces commander, SBU says
items.teaser: The ex-soldier parked a car with a bomb in its door outside the commander's home, with a dashcam in a second car set to film the blast, the SBU says.

items.title: Russen werfen eine 500-kg-Fliegerbombe auf Slowjansk ab
items.teaser: Die russische Besatzungsarmee hat eine 500 Kilogramm schwere FAB-500-Fliegerbombe auf das Zentrum von Slowjansk in der Region Donezk abgeworfen. Dabei wurde ein Mensch getötet und ein weiterer verletzt.

items.title: Russians strike community in Zhytomyr region again, injury toll rises to nine
items.teaser: Russian forces have launched a second attack on civilian infrastructure in the Malyn community, Zhytomyr region, killing one person and injuring nine others.

items.title: Most Russian ballistic and hypersonic missiles have gotten through since September, OSINT estimate says, as Patriot interceptors allies are financing sit unapproved
items.teaser: Ukraine's Air Force said in early November it was short of PAC-3 interceptors. About 40 are among the Patriot missiles US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has yet to approve, the FT reports.

items.title: Russian drone damages Dovzhenko Film Studio hostel in Kyiv – video, photos
items.teaser: Dovzhenko Film Studio has reported that an overnight Russian drone crash on 24-25 November blew out windows from the ground to the eighth floor of its hostel without injuring residents.

items.title: Black Friday bei Temu, Shein & Co: Wenn das Schnäppchen beim Zoll landet
items.teaser: Markensneaker für 39 Euro, dann kommt Post vom Zoll. Die EU-Kommission wirft Temu vor, zu wenig gegen illegale Angebote zu tun. Und die Kunden? Was diese von Verkäufer und Marktplatz verlangen können, erläutert

items.title: "She was the guardian of her family": woman injured in Russian strike on central Kryvyi Rih dies in hospital
items.teaser: Svitlana Kuropiatnik, who was injured in a Russian attack on central Kryvyi Rih on 20 November, has died in hospital. Doctors fought to save her life for five days but were unable to save her.

items.title: Khmara, Stoltenberg discuss strengthening Ukraine's air defenses and supporting defense industry
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Minister Yevhenii Khmara met with Norwegian Finance Minister Jens Stoltenberg during an official visit to Oslo to discuss strengthening Ukraine's air defenses and supporting the country’s defense industry.

items.title: Why Indian nationals are still ending up in Russia's war on Ukraine
items.teaser: Whether through deception or desperation, Indians continue to be drawn into Russia's war in Ukraine. What can New Delhi do to protect its citizens from ending up fighting in Ukraine?

items.title: Was über die rechtsextremistische Gruppe "Terror 18" bekannt ist
items.teaser: Sie sind fast noch Kinder und planten laut Bundesanwaltschaft schwerste Straftaten, etwa auf eine Flüchtlingsunterkunft. Nun gingen Ermittler gegen mutmaßliche Mitglieder der rechtsextremistischen Gruppe "Terror 18" vor. Was ist bekannt? Von Max Bauer.

items.title: How good is Ukraine’s Flamingo missile? Only 12 of 53 known launches strike their targets, OSINT count shows
items.teaser: The count lands as Kyiv denies reports it will move money from the Flamingo to the Neptune.

items.title: Ukrainische Verteidigungskräfte attackieren gleich zwei Raffinerien in Russland
items.teaser: Die Verteidigungskräfte der Ukraine haben in Zusammenarbeit mit der Freischärlerbewegung „Tschorna Iskra“ (Schwarzer Funke – deu.) zwei Ölraffinerien in der russischen Region Samara angegriffen.

items.title: Bundesanwaltschaft - Festnahme von drei mutmaßlichen Mitgliedern von rechtsextremistischer Gruppe
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft hat drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer rechtsextremistischen Vereinigung festnehmen lassen. Wie die Behörde mitteilte, handelt es sich um Jugendliche aus Brandenburg, Niedersachsen und Schleswig-Holstein.

items.title: Russia drops 500-kg FAB-500 bomb on Sloviansk
items.teaser: Russian forces have dropped a 500-kilogram FAB-500 glide bomb on central Sloviansk in the Donetsk region, killing one person and injuring another.

items.title: Notstromabschaltungen in fünf Regionen infolge russischer Angriffe
items.teaser: Nach dem russischen Drohnen- und Raketenangriff wurden am Mittwoch, dem 25. November, in fünf Regionen der Ukraine Stromausfälle gemeldet.

items.title: Ukraine ready for next POW exchange, Coordination Headquarters secretary says
items.teaser: Dmytro Usov, secretary of Ukraine’s Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War, visited Russian POWs at a detention camp.

items.title: Ukraine: Industrial attacks and anger at Russia as Ukraine's allies justify defense aid, argue over military action in Libya
items.teaser: Moscow and Kyiv traded infrastructure attacks as allies argued over Ukraine's actions in Libya. Poland says it is puzzled by the lack of a US response to Russian incursions in its airspace. Follow DW for the latest.

items.title: Ukraine’s first Lynx IFVs arrive with airburst shells and a counter-drone role they weren’t optimized for
items.teaser: Troops plan to fire 30mm airburst rounds at enemy drones, though The War Zone notes the vehicle has no visible radar.

items.title: Parliament approves Ukraine’s accession to Steering Committee of Special Tribunal on Russian Aggression
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada has ratified the Enlarged Partial Agreement on the Steering Committee of the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine, a key step toward securing the tribunal’s funding and enabling it to begin operations.

items.title: "Wildberries has just ditched us": Russian sellers complain in droves about unpaid compensation
items.teaser: Russian sellers say Wildberries has failed to compensate them for goods destroyed in warehouse fires or pay them for items already sold.

items.title: HUR deep-strike destroys Russia’s unique aerospace reconnaissance system
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Intelligence (HUR) has destroyed a Russian aerospace reconnaissance and information system in a deep-strike operation.

items.title: Hungary considers buying Ukrainian maize and selling diesel fuel to Ukraine
items.teaser: Hungary is considering importing Ukrainian maize to address domestic shortages and selling surplus diesel fuel to Ukraine as part of closer economic and energy cooperation.

items.title: Ukraine needs at least €115 billion to hold firm in 2027. Zelenskyy expects €90 billion from the EU, and €25 billion has yet to be found
items.teaser: Half of that EU money is a new loan four member states want no part of, and Berlin has made the EU budget conditional on every member state helping fund Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine's PM says overnight Russian attacks targeted energy and logistics
items.teaser: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi has said overnight Russian strikes targeted substations, power generation facilities, power lines and gas sites in four oblasts – with Zaporizhzhia the hardest hit. One person was killed in Kyiv Oblast

items.title: Russian attack on industrial facility and parking lot in Zhytomyr Region kills one, injures five
items.teaser: One person was killed and five others injured in a Russian attack on the Malyn community in Zhytomyr region.

items.title: "Terror 18": Drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder von rechtsextremer Gruppe festgenommen
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft hat die mutmaßlich rechtsextremistische Gruppe "Terror 18" zerschlagen. Bei einer bundesweiten Razzia sind drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder festgenommen worden. Unter ihnen ist auch ein Jugendlicher aus Brandenburg.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 9, injure 59 across Ukraine over past day, halt power generation at thermal power plant
items.teaser: Russian forces launched 112 drones, including 66 jet-powered ones, and decoys at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 24, the Air Force said.

items.title: Ukrainian soldier rescued a dog during the Kursk Operation. Now she’s his constant companion
items.teaser: Vladyslav Budivskyi, a platoon commander in the unmanned systems unit of the 199th Air Assault Forces Training Center, rescued an exhausted German-Australian Shepherd in Sudzha during the Kursk operation. The dog, whom he named Princess, now goes everywhere with him.

items.title: Ukrainian forces have struck aircraft at Russia's Savasleyka airbase, General Staff reports
items.teaser: Ukraine's General Staff says five aircraft have been hit at the Savasleyka airbase in Russia’s Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, particularly three MiG-31s and two Su-34s.

items.title: "Terror 18": Rechtsextreme Jugendgruppe plante offenbar Anschlag - Festnahmen

items.title: Naftogaz facility in Poltava Region halts operations after Russian attack
items.teaser: Russian forces have struck a Naftogaz Group facility in Ukraine’s Poltava region, forcing it to suspend operations.

items.title: US-Botschaft rät US-Bürgern angesichts der russischen Angriffe davon ab, in die Ukraine zu reisen
items.teaser: Die Botschaft der Vereinigten Staaten rieg ihre Bürger dazu auf, wegen der russischen Luftangriffe auf Reisen in die Ukraine zu verzichten.

items.title: Ukraine’s Defense Forces strike Savasleyka airfield, destroy five aircraft used in attacks on Ukraine
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Defense Forces have struck the Russian Savasleyka airfield, which hosts MiG-31K aircraft capable of carrying Kinzhal missiles.

items.title: Ukrainische Angriffe auf russische Schiffe: Weitet der Konflikt sich aus?
items.teaser: Attacken auf russische Schiffe reichen inzwischen bis ins Mittelmeer. Kiew setzt Moskau global unter Druck - mit möglichen Folgen für Europa und den Handel auf den Weltmeeren. Wie groß ist die Gefahr einer Eskalation?

items.title: Two injured in Russian attack on Zlatopil in Kharkiv Oblast
items.teaser: Two men were injured in a Russian attack on the city of Zlatopil in Kharkiv Oblast on 25 November.

items.title: Razzia bei rechtsextremistischer Gruppe "Terror 18"
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft ist in mehreren Bundesländern gegen die rechtsextremistische Gruppe "Terror 18" vorgegangen, die schwerste Straftaten geplant haben soll. Drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder wurden festgenommen - sie sind 14 und 15 Jahre alt.

items.title: Council of EU imposes stricter export restrictions on 15 Russian companies
items.teaser: The Council of the European Union decided on 25 November to add 15 Russian entities to the list of those subject to stricter export restrictions on dual-use goods and advanced technologies.

items.title: Ukraine passes landmark crypto bill that could generate $300 million annually
items.teaser: The bill sets a general income tax rate of 18% and a 5% military tax on transactions involving virtual assets. In the first year after the law comes into effect, withdrawals converted into traditional currency would be taxed at a preferential 5% rate.

items.title: Trump says he has set no deadline for Ukraine-Russia peace deal
items.teaser: U.S. President Donald Trump said he had set no deadline for reaching a peace deal between Ukraine and Russia, saying he hoped the war would end as soon as possible.

items.title: Ukrainian intelligence destroys Russian aerospace reconnaissance system in Smolensk Oblast
items.teaser: Defence Intelligence of Ukraine says the system could detect low-radar-signature aircraft and cruise missiles at distances of up to 2,500 km

items.title: Samara double strike: Ukrainian defence forces strike two Rosneft oil refineries
items.teaser: Two oil refineries caught fire in Russia's Samara Oblast on the night of 24-25 November. Ukraine's defence forces struck the Kuibyshev oil refinery in Samara and the Syzran oil refinery in Syzran.

items.title: Putin ousts filmmaker from token human rights council in move against even curated dissent
items.teaser: Alexander Sokurov, best known abroad for his 2002 experimental film "Russian Ark," was a member of the so-called council since 2018. All of its members are hand-picked by Putin.

items.title: German-Ukrainian SPYS interceptor downs Russia’s new K5-K jet Geran in combat trials, maker says
items.teaser: The maker announced the kill the same day its 520 km/h record was reported, but its own speed figures keep changing.

items.title: One injured and apartment building damaged in Russian attack on Odesa, power and water supply disrupted
items.teaser: Russian drones attacked Odesa on the afternoon of 25 November, damaging an apartment building. One person is reported to have been injured. The attack has also disrupted electricity and water supplies and brought electric-powered public transport to a halt.

items.title: Latvian PM promises good news on Ukrainian grain exports
items.teaser: “Good news” on the transit and export of Ukrainian grain through Latvia is expected soon.

items.title: AfD fordert Klage gegen Haushalt - Merz nennt Etat "vertretbar"
items.teaser: Die Aufstellung des Haushalts habe "keinen Schönheitspreis verdient“, räumte der Kanzler ein. Doch er sei in der gegenwärtigen Lage vertretbar. Zuvor war er von AfD-Chef Chrupalla scharf kritisiert worden - auch in Sachen Ukraine.

items.title: Parliament approves Ukraine's accession to management committee of special tribunal for Russia
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada (Ukrainian Parliament) voted on Wednesday 25 November in favour of Ukraine joining the Enlarged Partial Agreement on the Management Committee of the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine. The bill was backed by 293 MPs.

items.title: Russian attack on Bila Tserkva kills one person, damages DIY superstore and Nova Poshta branch
items.teaser: One person was killed when Russian forces attacked the city of Bila Tserkva and the surrounding district in Kyiv Oblast overnight on 24-25 November. An Epicentr home improvement superstore, a branch of delivery service Nova Poshta and other civilian businesses were damaged.

items.title: Ukraine’s parliament passes law to legalize cryptocurrency
items.teaser: Ukrainian parliament, the Verkhovna Rada, has passed legislation legalizing the cryptocurrency market and establishing a tax framework for virtual asset transactions.

items.title: Rada verabschiedet Gesetz zur Legalisierung von Kryptowährungen
items.teaser: Die Werchowna Rada (Parlament – Anm. d. Red.) hat ein Gesetz zur Legalisierung von Kryptowährungen verabschiedet.

items.title: Berehove could become a symbol of Ukraine-Hungary cooperation – Mayor
items.teaser: Berehove Mayor Zoltán Babják called the Ukrainian-Hungarian leaders’ meeting in the city a historic event for the community and an opportunity to attract investment.

items.title: New €45 billion support instrument to cover two-thirds of Ukraine’s 2027 Needs – von der Leyen
items.teaser: The European Union will continue to provide comprehensive support to Ukraine, from funding hospitals and schools to supplying drones and interceptors. It has proposed a new €45 billion financing mechanism to support Ukraine in 2027.

items.title: One person killed, four injured as Russian forces attack enterprise in Zhytomyr region
items.teaser: One person was killed and four others injured in a Russian attack on the Malyn community in the Zhytomyr region.

items.title: Ukrainian drones made in Canada? TAF Industries signs its first partnership beyond Europe
items.teaser: TAF says it and Canada's Draganfly intend to make drones in Canada mainly for Ukraine's Armed Forces. Zelenskyy's office said in September that Ukraine would get 30% of drones from a Ukrainian-Canadian program.

items.title: German chancellor: Russia wants more than Ukraine
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz says Russia is escalating tensions in the Baltic region, Poland, the Black Sea and outer space, as well as within Germany.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia NPP loses external power supply after Russian attack
items.teaser: The Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant lost its external power supply following a Russian attack and is currently operating on diesel generators.

items.title: AKW Saporischschja verliert nach russischem Beschuss externe Stromversorgung
items.teaser: Das Kernkraftwerk Saporischschja hat aufgrund feindlichen Beschusses die externe Stromversorgung verloren.

items.title: Estonia’s FM arrives in Kyiv
items.teaser: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna has arrived in Kyiv on an official visit.

items.title: Russian attack severely damages thermal power plant, forcing shutdown
items.teaser: Ukraine's largest private energy company DTEK has reported that a massive Russian strike has severely damaged equipment at one of its thermal power plants, halting generation for the third time in November

items.title: Results of Zelensky-Magyar meeting expected in January-February, ambassador says
items.teaser: Ukraine’s Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary to Hungary, Fedir Shandor, said that the results of the meeting between President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar would become clear in January-February.

items.title: Ukrainian parliament legalises cryptocurrency and establishes taxation rules
items.teaser: The Verkhovna Rada (Ukrainian Parliament) has passed a law establishing new rules for the cryptocurrency market at its second reading.

items.title: Razzia bei rechter Terrorgruppe – Jugendliche festgenommen
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft hat drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer rechtsextremistischen Terrorgruppe festnehmen lassen.

items.title: One killed and three injured in yet another Russian attack on Zhytomyr Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a car park in the Malyn hromada in Zhytomyr Oblast on the morning of 25 November, killing one person and injuring three others after earlier overnight strikes hit regional energy and business sites

items.title: "Terror 18": Razzia bei rechtsextremistischer deutscher Gruppe
items.teaser: Deutschlandweite Durchsuchungen und Festnahmen in drei Bundesländern: Im Visier der Ermittler stehen mehrere Jugendliche. Was hat das mit der Internetgruppe "Terror 18" zu tun?

items.title: Time includes photos from Ukraine in its Top 100 Photos of 2026
items.teaser: Works by Kostiantyn Liberov, Serhii Korovainyi, Marylise Vigneau, Mauricio Lima, Johanna Maria Fritz and Gerd Ludwig in Ukraine were selected for Time's Top 100 Photos of 2026.

items.title: SSU foils assassination attempt on commander of Special Operations Forces unit
items.teaser: The SSU military counterintelligence department in the Kharkiv region, with the assistance of the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine and the command of the Ukrainian Special Operations Forces, foiled a contract killing plot targeting the commander of one of the Defense Forces' largest classified units.

items.title: Wohnungen durchsucht: Razzia bei rechter Terrorgruppe - Jugendliche festgenommen
items.teaser: Die Bundesanwaltschaft lässt drei mutmaßliche Mitglieder einer rechtsextremistischen Terrorgruppe festnehmen. Sie soll unter anderem einen Brandanschlag auf eine Flüchtlingsunterkunft geplant haben. In mehreren Bundesländern finden Durchsuchungen statt.

items.title: Estonian foreign minister arrives in Kyiv
items.teaser: Estonian Foreign Minister Margus Tsahkna has arrived in Ukraine on a visit.

items.title: International Arbitration in a Changing World: China Arbitration Summit 2026
items.teaser: The China Arbitration Summit and High-Level Dialogue on Maritime and Commercial Arbitration (the “Summit”) was held on 18 September 2026 as the flagship event of China Arbitration Week 2026 . items.title: Russia has around 100 troops inside Kupiansk, with no sign of encirclement – Tregubov
items.teaser: The number of Russian troops who have managed to infiltrate Kupiansk remains at around 100.

items.title: Gas facility in Poltava Oblast halts operations due to Russian strike
items.teaser: Acting Naftogaz CEO Serhii Fedorenko reported that a Russian attack on gas production infrastructure in Poltava Oblast overnight on 24-25 November triggered a major fire and halted operations at the facility

items.title: Generalstab meldet binnen eines Tages über 200 Gefechte an der Front, die Mehrheit davon in Richtung Pokrowsk 28 Angriffe gestoppt
items.teaser: Am 24. November kam es zu 203 Gefechten zwischen den ukrainischen Verteidigern und den russischen Angreifern an der Front, wobei die meisten feindlichen Angriffe im Raum Pokrowsk stattfanden.

items.title: Police post photos of 16-storey Kyiv apartment block damaged by Russian drone
items.teaser: Law enforcement officers have posted photos of damaged buildings, a kindergarten, a hotel and cars in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district after Russian drone debris struck a 16-storey residential block on 24 November

items.title: Ukraine reports new power outages as occupied Zaporizhzhia nuclear plant switches to diesel generators
items.teaser: Russian attacks have caused new power outages in five Ukrainian oblasts, while the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant has lost external power for the 17th time this year.

items.title: Injury toll in Russian attack on Kyiv rises to three
items.teaser: The number of people injured after a Russian drone struck the courtyard of an apartment building in Kyiv’s Shevchenkivskyi district in the evening of November 24 has risen to three.

items.title: In Region Cherson ein Zivilist verletzt, 32 Ortschaften beschossen
items.teaser: Letzten Tag beschoss die russische Besatzungsarmee 32 Siedlungen in der Region Cherson. Bei Beschuss wurde ein Zivilist verletzt.

items.title: Merz: "Russland will mehr als die Ukraine"
items.teaser: Kanzler Merz räumt Defizite bei der Aufstellung des Haushalts ein, halte ihn aber für "vertretbar". Er wirbt für weitere Ukraine-Unterstützung und warnt vor Russlands Eskalationsversuchen.

items.title: Russian forces strike Zaporizhzhia in morning attack, injuries, damage reported
items.teaser: Three people were injured in a Russian attack on the Shevchenkivskyi district of Zaporizhzhia on Wednesday morning, November 25.

items.title: The UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise: Affirming Status, Encouraging Co-operation
items.teaser: Introduction On 12 October 2026, the General Assembly formally endorsed, without a vote, the UN Declaration on Sea Level Rise (‘the Declaration’; A/81/L.3, GA/12794). Mandated by the General Assembly in 2024 (Decision 78/558), the Declaration was first approved by consensus at a high-level meeting on 24 September 2026

items.title: Russen beschießen vier Ortschaften und töten einen Zivilisten in Region Donezk
items.teaser: Am 24. November töteten russische Besatzungstruppen in der Region Donezk einen Zivilisten, teilte der Leiter der Donezker Militärverwaltung Wadym Filaschkin auf Facebook mit, berichtet Ukrinform.

items.title: Russian drone attack on Volyn region injures five, fire at enterprise extinguished
items.teaser: Five people were injured in a Russian attack in the Kovel district of the Volyn region in the evening of November 24.

items.title: Exclusive: US rules out troops, military bases in Ukraine under post-war security guarantees, falling short of Kyiv's expectations
items.teaser: Meanwhile, France, Italy, and the U.K. are among those supportive of bringing Ukraine into NATO, according to a readout of a Nov. 19 Coalition of the Willing meeting provided to the Kyiv Independent.

items.title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,643,580 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
items.teaser: The number includes 2,091 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

items.title: Two Rosneft oil refineries in Russia’s Samara region on fire following drone attack – media
items.teaser: A fire broke out at an oil refinery in the city of Syzran, Samara region, Russia, on Wednesday amid a drone attack.

items.title: Zwei Rosneft-Raffinerien in russischer Region Samara brennen nach Drohnenangriff
items.teaser: In der Stadt Sysran in der Region Samara der Russischen Föderation kam es am Mittwoch, den 25. November nach einem Drohnenangriff zu einem Brand in einer Ölraffinerie.

items.title: Russian drones attack civilian and energy infrastructure in Zhytomyr region, one person injured
items.teaser: Russian drones targeted civilian and energy infrastructure in the Zhytomyr region, injuring one person.

items.title: War update: Over 200 clashes on front lines over past day, Pokrovsk axis hottest
items.teaser: As many as 203 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invading forces were recorded along the front line on November 24, with the highest number of Russian attacks on the Pokrovsk axis.

items.title: One killed, seven injured as Russian drone hits minibus in Kharkiv region
items.teaser: A Russian drone attacked a minibus in Chuhuiv district, Kharkiv region, killing one person and injuring seven others.

items.title: Russia's war casualty toll in Ukraine up by 2,091 over past day
items.teaser: The total combat losses of Russian forces in the war against Ukraine from February 24, 2022, to November 25, 2026, have reached approximately 1,643,580 personnel, including 2,091 troops killed or wounded over the past 24 hours.

items.title: Russia to step up influence operations against Western countries – expert
items.teaser: Western countries should prepare for an increase in Russian disinformation operations in the near future.

items.title: Russian attack kills 1, damages commercial infrastructure in Kyiv Oblast
items.teaser: Local Telegram channel Kyiv Holovne reported damage to facilities belonging to Ukrainian home improvement retailer Epicentr and postal and logistics company Nova Poshta, as well as other civilian businesses.

items.title: Days before key summit, EU countries want to help Ukraine, but can't agree on how
items.teaser: BRUSSELS, Belgium — Ukraine support has emerged as a rare point of consensus for EU countries otherwise at loggerheads over the future size and shape of the bloc's next long-term budget, but confusion reigns over every aspect of that support for Kyiv, according to several dispatches back to

items.title: Libya: 2 dead after Ukrainian attack on Russian warship in Benghazi
items.teaser: The head of the eastern administration in Libya has confirmed that two Libyan soldiers succumbed to their injuries. Ukraine's foreign minister defended the attack as an effort to counter Russian aggression.

items.title: Russian forces reduce assault attempts in Kharkiv region – SBGS
items.teaser: Russian forces have reduced their assault activity in the Kharkiv sector over the past week due to preventive actions by Ukraine's Defense Forces and deteriorating weather conditions.

items.title: Brücken-Krieg: Gefahr für Kiew, Probleme für Russlands Logistik
items.teaser: Kiew, Saporischschja, Odessa - immer wieder greift Russland ukrainische Brücken an. Im Gegenzug schießt die Ukraine vermehrt zurück - auch auf die Krim-Brücke. Dabei geht es beiden Seiten nicht immer nur um militärische Ziele. Von R. Barth.

items.title: Moldova and Romania plan to develop Prut River navigation with links to Ukraine
items.teaser: Moldova has proposed working with Romania to develop river infrastructure and restore navigation on the Prut River, partly to strengthen transport links with Ukraine.

items.title: Ukrainian drones reportedly strike 2 Russian oil refineries in massive attack
items.teaser: Ukrainian forces struck two Russian oil refineries, setting the sites ablaze in a massive attack overnight on Nov. 25, monitoring channels reported.

items.title: Officer suspected of torturing subordinates extradited from Mondova to Ukraine
items.teaser: A Ukrainian serviceman suspected of ill-treating his subordinates has been extradited from Moldova to Ukraine.

items.title: German city of Darmstadt donates generators to schools and kindergartens in Uzhhorod
items.teaser: A delegation from the German city of Darmstadt, led by Mayor Hanno Benz, has donated five high-capacity generators worth more than €116,000 to Uzhhorod to ensure uninterrupted operations at schools and kindergartens.

items.title: Russian attacks kill 2 in Odesa Oblast, including child, injure more in Kyiv
items.teaser: A Russian attack on Odesa Oblast killed two people, including a teenager, and injured one other person, while another strike on a Kyiv residential building courtyard injured two people in Ukraine's capital late on Nov. 24.

items.title: SSU arrests suspected Russian agent posing as volunteer to direct strikes on Kramatorsk
items.teaser: Counterintelligence unit of the Security Service of Ukraine (SSU) has arrested a contract soldier who, according to investigators, had gone AWOL from his military unit and was helping Russian forces direct strikes on Kramatorsk in the Donetsk region.

items.title: Most Germans now oppose arming Ukraine. Far-right voters resist hardest: 88% against
items.teaser: Support has dropped 13 points in a year, even as Germany gave Kyiv €11.5 billion in 2026, a third of all partner aid.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1735: Ukrainian sources say Pentagon chief has not signed off on 60 Patriot missiles that allies paid for
items.teaser: Zelenskyy says Ukraine needs more F-16s and Gripens against Russia's jet-powered Shaheds, Ukraine is preparing its big cities for water and sewage outages after Russian strikes, and the EU has proposed a 22nd sanctions package.

items.title: Norwegian firm behind NASAMS air defense builds new system around cheap Ukrainian missiles. Called Desna, it already fires at Russian drones, Oslo says
items.teaser: Air defense missiles run short worldwide. Ukraine and Norway answer with Desna.

items.title: Debris from Russian drone causes fire in 16-story residential building in Kyiv
items.teaser: A fire broke out in a 16-story residential building in Kyiv's Shevchenkivskyi district after debris from a Russian drone fell on it.

items.title: Zelensky presents Magyar with 1942 newspapers mentioning his great-grandfather, who worked in Mukachevo
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has presented Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar with historical newspapers from 1942 that mention his great-grandfather, who worked as a notary in Mukachevo. Magyar also recalled his first visit to the Zakarpattia region, where he brought humanitarian aid as a school student.

items.title: Hungary sees Ukraine's EU accession as lengthy process – Magyar
items.teaser: Hungary will continue providing humanitarian assistance to Ukraine but does not agree to linking its funding to the European Union's seven-year budget and views EU accession as a lengthy process.

items.title: Around 100 civilians trapped on occupied Kinburn Spit face winter without food or medicine. Ukraine seeks a humanitarian evacuation similar to Oleshky
items.teaser: Russian forces are preventing residents from leaving the isolated peninsula, while shortages of food and essential medicines put the mostly elderly population at risk.

items.title: Russian drones strike Merefa, Lozova in Kharkiv region, six injured
items.teaser: Russian drones struck the cities of Merefa and Lozova in the Kharkiv region on the evening of November 24, injuring six people.

items.title: "Russisches Starlink" - Wie kann Rasswet den Ukraine-Krieg verändern?
items.teaser: Das US-Starlink-System von SpaceX spielt in der Ukraine eine wichtige Rolle bei der Abwehr der militärischen Aggression Russlands. Der Kreml hat nun beschlossen, ein Pendant dazu aufzubauen. Welche Gefahr birgt das?

items.title: Russian strikes on Odesa region kill two, including 17-year-old boy, injure three
items.teaser: Russian forces struck the Odesa region on the evening of November 24, killing a man and a 17-year-old boy and injuring three people.

items.title: People in occupied Donetsk and Luhansk are asking Putin to turn the lights back on. Two petitions have drawn over 55,000 signatures
items.teaser: Occupied Crimea will get 30% less power for up to ten days from 25 November, its Moscow-installed head said.

items.title: Ukraine seeks equal partnership with Hungary, support for its EU integration – Zelensky
items.teaser: Ukraine seeks equal partnership with Hungary, support for its European integration path, and closer bilateral cooperation in energy, trade, infrastructure and security.

items.title: Rescuer killed in Russian shelling of Kramatorsk
items.teaser: A rescuer has been killed in a Russian attack on Kramatorsk.

items.title: Zehn Jahre nach FARC-Abkommen: Dutzende Verletzte bei Anschlag in Kolumbien
items.teaser: 2016 schließen die kolumbianische Regierung und die FARC ein Friedensabkommen. Fast auf den Tag genau zehn Jahre später explodiert eine Autobombe in der Stadt Villavicencio. Der Präsident macht eine Rebellen-Splittergruppe für den Anschlag verantwortlich.

items.title: Presidential Medal of Freedom: Donald Trump gewährt Rudy Giuliani höchste Ehren
items.teaser: Berühmt wurde er als Bürgermeister, als Terroristen das World Trade Center in New York angriffen. Doch in den vergangenen Jahren machte Rudy Giuliani vor allem mit Skandalen von sich reden - und als Anwalt von Donald Trump. Der zeichnet ihn nun aus.

items.title: Ukraine allocates nearly UAH 2B for distributed generation this year – Shmyhal
items.teaser: About UAH 2 billion was allocated from the state budget this year to develop distributed generation in Ukrainian communities.

items.title: Two killed and three injured, including child, in Russian attacks on Odesa Oblast – photo
items.teaser: Two people, aged 41 and 17, have been killed and three others, including a 12-year-old child, have been injured in Russian attacks on Odesa Oblast.

items.title: Russian forces strike civilian enterprise in Balakliia community
items.teaser: Russian invaders have struck a civilian enterprise in the Borshchivka district of the Balakliia community in the Kharkiv region.

items.title: Verteidigungsminister: Ukraine und Norwegen skalieren Produktion eines neuen Luftverteidigungssystems
items.teaser: Die Ukraine und Norwegen haben die Produktion eines neuen Luftabwehrsystems gestartet und werden die skalieren. Es handelt sich um die Abschussanlage DESNA, die bereits in der Ukraine eingesetzt wird.

items.title: Zelensky says comprehensive solution to counter Russian glide bombs will be found
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that a comprehensive solution to counter guided aerial bombs will be found.

items.title: Anschlag in Magdeburg: Gut sechs Millionen Euro Hilfen an Betroffene ausgezahlt
items.teaser: An Betroffene des Anschlags in Magdeburg sind bisher gut sechs Millionen Euro an Hilfen ausgezahlt worden. Am zweiten Jahrestag des Anschlags soll der Weihnachtsmarkt öffnen – allerdings verkürzt.

items.title: Russia now goes after Ukraine’s water, not only its power. City without sewage faces epidemic within three days, a Kyiv water utility official warns
items.teaser: Ukraine is preparing its large cities for water and sewage outages after Russian strikes.

items.title: Ukraine war latest: 'Evacuation, air raid,' — Russian military aircraft approach South Korean island, trigger alert
items.teaser: Key developments on Nov. 24: 'Evacuation, air raid,' — Russian military aircraft approach South Korean island, trigger air raid alert Zelensky confirms Ukrainian attack on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland Russia breaks yearly troop losses record in Ukraine at 432,519 casualties, General Staff says Ukraine, Norway

items.title: EU’s new sanctions proposal takes aim at Russian war funding and sports participation as sporting world moves to readmit Russian athletes
items.teaser: The European Commission wants to tighten restrictions on Russian banks, energy projects, and military suppliers, while proposing an entry ban for former combatants and further limits on Russian participation in European sports.

items.title: Zelenskyy summarises meeting with Hungarian PM: energy, trade and support discussed
items.teaser: Péter Magyar and Volodymyr Zelenskyy discussed gas and diesel supplies, trade, humanitarian demining and new rail routes during their meeting in Uzhhorod.

items.title: Around 100 civilians trapped on Russian-occupied Kinburn Spit face severe food, medicine shortages, Ukrainian military says
items.teaser: Most of those remaining in the villages of Pokrovske, Vasylivka, and Heroiske are elderly residents who have been unable to evacuate due to extensive Russian minefields and restrictions imposed by occupying forces.

items.title: Zelensky outlines what could force Russia to agree to a ceasefire
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky said that the resilience and unity of Ukraine’s partners – the United States and Europe – combined with Russia’s heavy battlefield losses and mounting economic costs, would eventually force Moscow to agree to a ceasefire.

items.title: Russian drone strikes civilian car in Sumy: 76-year-old man killed
items.teaser: A Russian fibre-optic FPV drone hit a civilian car in Sumy's Kovpakivskyi district, killing a 76-year-old passenger; his son, the driver, is in hospital.

items.title: Ukraine and Hungary discuss gas and diesel supplies, new rail links

items.title: Hundreds of Ukrainian defense tech companies already use AI – Zelensky

items.title: Über 432,5 Tausend Soldaten seit Jahresbeginn: russische Verluste erreichen neuen Rekord

items.title: Ukraine can cover only a third of its 2027 funding needs with domestic resources – Koretskyi
items.teaser: Ukraine can cover only about one-third of its funding needs for 2027 from domestic resources and expects to secure the remainder from international partners. Meanwhile, local communities must step up winter preparations and strengthen security measures, regardless of their location in the country.

items.title: Ukrainian foreign minister advises Putin to stop complaining about strikes on oil refineries and end war instead
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has responded to Russian ruler Vladimir Putin's complaints about Ukrainian strikes on Russian oil refineries, advising him to order an end to the war instead.

items.title: Number of Russian attacks on Naftogaz facilities since start of war exceeds 800
items.teaser: Naftogaz says its facilities have been struck more than 800 times since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion, but its plants continue producing oil and gas.

items.title: Belarusian leader says he could fly to Putin with Zelenskyy on same plane
items.teaser: The Belarusian leader says he could act as Zelenskyy's security guarantor during a trip to Moscow, claiming the three leaders could agree on ending the war.

items.title: Russen greifen Wohnhochhaus in Dnipro an: sechs Menschen verletzt
items.teaser: Russische Truppen haben im Laufe des Tages fast 30 - mal die Region Dnipropetrowsk mit Drohnen und Artillerie angegriffen. In der Regionhauptstadt Dnipro wurden sechs Personen verletzt.

items.teaser: As the city wakes up, dozens of people stream across Kyiv's Southern Bridge, walking over the Dnipro River on their way to work. Until recently, the same journey took just minutes by metro. Now, with that option gone, their daily commute can stretch into hours. While Russian attacks

items.title: UK warns companies supplying Ukraine of Russian sabotage threat
items.teaser: British officials said Russia had stepped up sabotage attempts against European defense facilities in recent months, often using recruited operatives to carry out arson attacks and other operations aimed at weakening support for Ukraine. items.title: Injury toll in Russian strike on Dnipro apartment building rises to six
items.teaser: Russian forces launched nearly 30 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region throughout the day, injuring six people in the city of Dnipro.

items.title: Hungarian PM says he hosted refugees from Zakarpattia Oblast
items.teaser: Prime Minister Péter Magyar says Hungary has provided refuge to tens of thousands of Ukrainians since Russia's full-scale invasion, including many ethnic Hungarians.

items.title: "Categorical objection": Ukrainian government responds to appointment of Russian official to senior IAEA post
items.teaser: Kyiv says Aleksei Ferapontov was involved in Russia's seizure of the Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant and demands that the IAEA reverse his appointment.

items.title: Britischer Verteidigungsminister besucht Frontstadt Charkiw und kündigt Lieferung zusätzlicher RapidRanger-Starter an
items.teaser: Der britische Verteidigungsminister Wes Streeting hat die ostukrainische Frontstadt Charkiw besucht, wie The Guardian berichtet.

items.title: Putin complains that Ukraine is striking Russian oil refineries despite Trump's request and vows retaliation
items.teaser: Russian ruler Vladimir Putin claims Ukraine ignored Trump's direct request to stop attacking oil facilities and says Moscow's response is inevitable.

items.title: Ukraine says it hit over 4,000 Russian ground robots in 2026 and that the losses force Russia to put troops and armor into supply runs
items.teaser: The Ukrainian General Staff's separate tally since 2022 is lower: 3,213 ground robots as of 23 November.

items.title: Hungarian PM announces aid for Zakarpattia Oblast during visit to Uzhhorod
items.teaser: During his visit to Uzhhorod, Prime Minister Péter Magyar also announced a new social support fund for Hungarians living abroad.

items.title: Ukraine to scale up DESNA air defense launcher production jointly with Norway
items.teaser: Ukraine and Norway have jointly developed the DESNA air defense launcher and are now working to scale up its production and deployment. The system is already in service with Ukraine’s forces.

items.title: Estonia sending signal to Ukraine not to pollute Baltic Sea – Estonian PM
items.teaser: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Tallinn will signal to Ukraine about Baltic Sea pollution risks from strikes on Russian shadow fleet tankers.

items.title: Kyiv Appeals Court upholds detention of woman accused of posing as paramedic during clashes at National Guard facility
items.teaser: The Kyiv Court of Appeal has upheld the pretrial detention without bail of a woman suspected of obstructing the operations of a National Guard of Ukraine unit in Kyiv region.

items.title: Kinder in Region Donezk zwangsevakuiert
items.teaser: Die unter nadauernedem russischem Beschuss leidende ostukrainische Region Donezk hat die Zwangsevakuierung von Familien mit Kindern aus 2 weiteren grenznahen Gemeinden angeordnet.

items.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy and Hungary's Magyar meet amid thaw in ties
items.teaser: Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar has arrived in Ukraine for meetings with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and ethnic Hungarians. Both leaders say they want better relations after a change of leadership in Budapest.

items.title: Ukraine, Norway to expand joint DESNA air defense system as Oslo plans $7 billion in 2027 aid
items.teaser: The ministers also discussed supplying additional combat aircraft and ammunition, expanding cooperation on unmanned systems, and scaling up cooperation through joint production projects and the exchange of battlefield experience.

items.title: Russia has targeted Naftogaz facilities more than 800 times since the full-scale invasion
items.teaser: Russian forces have carried out more than 800 attacks on Naftogaz Group facilities since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: Ukraine's bid for NATO membership and more air defense remains controversial
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is calling for the rapid acceptance of his country into NATO. However, the necessary unanimity for this is lacking, as shown during the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin.

items.title: Ukraine's defence minister announces major air defence agreements with Norway
items.teaser: Ukrainian Defence Minister Yevhenii Khmara met Norway's Tore O. Sandvik in Oslo, announcing major air defence deals and at least US$7 billion in 2027 aid.

items.title: Two women injured as Russian drone hits homes and shop in Chernihiv Region
items.teaser: A Russian drone strike has damaged several private homes and a shop in the town of Snovsk, in the Koriukivka district of Chernihiv Region, leaving two women injured.

items.title: Intelligence warns of potential Russian attacks on British companies supporting Ukraine – media
items.teaser: British companies and organisations providing assistance to Ukraine’s Defense Forces, including by supplying weapons components and equipment or providing logistical support, have been warned by the government that they could become targets of Russian sabotage.

items.title: Sweden announces winter support package for Ukraine
items.teaser: Sweden announced a winter aid package for Ukraine on 24 November, including funding for the Ukrainian Red Cross, the energy sector and civil defence.

items.title: Italy’s Foreign Minister voices concern over Ukraine’s strike on Russian vessels in Libya
items.teaser: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani has voiced concern to his Ukrainian counterpart, Andrii Sybiha, over Ukraine’s attack on Russian vessels in the Libyan port of Benghazi.

items.title: Moldova proposes reviving Prut River navigation with Romania, strengthening links with Ukraine
items.teaser: Moldova has proposed restoring navigation on the Prut River to Romania, starting with a Giurgiulești-Galați pilot section to boost transport links with Ukraine.

items.title: Russians strike business in Rivne Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces struck a civilian business in the Sarny district in Rivne Oblast on 24 November, sparking a fire, with no casualties reported so far.

items.title: Magyar reports significant progress in talks with Ukraine on rights of Hungarian minority
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar said significant progress had been made in talks with the Ukrainian side on ten issues concerning the language, cultural and educational rights of the Hungarian national minority in Ukraine.

items.title: Russia breaks yearly troop losses record in Ukraine at 432,519 casualties, General Staff says

items.title: Zelensky makes first statement after meeting with Magyar in Uzhhorod
items.teaser: President Volodymyr Zelensky made his first statement to the press after paying tribute to fallen Ukrainian soldiers in Uzhhorod alongside Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar.

items.title: Germany set to be first NATO country to use DELTA, Ukraine’s battle command system. Berlin will adapt it for its forces and help build new features
items.teaser: However, Berlin will not get access to Ukraine's combat data.

items.title: Zelenskyy and Hungarian PM Magyar honour fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod – video
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar met in Uzhhorod on 24 November to honour Ukraine's fallen defenders.

items.teaser: In der westukrainischen Stadt Uschhorod haben der Präsident der Ukraine, Wolodymyr Selenskyj und der ungarische Ministerpräsident Péter Magyar die gefallenen Verteidiger der Ukraine geehrt, wie der Ukrinform - Korrespondent berichtet.

items.title: UK defence secretary visits Kharkiv, announces additional RapidRanger launchers for Ukraine
items.teaser: UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting visited the Ukrainian city of Kharkiv, located just 20 kilometers from the front line.

items.title: What can Ukraine expect in 2027? KI Insights monthly briefing
items.teaser: Ukraine enters 2027 with a wartime budget, a large financing gap, and a diplomatic track that could change everything or nothing. items.teaser: "The Government is carefully considering the recommendations of the Senate report to ensure Australia's sanctions on Russia remain fit for purpose, and will table a response in due course," Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong wrote to civil society coalition B4Ukraine.

items.title: Zelensky and Magyar pay tribute to fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar paid tribute to fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod.

items.title: Hungarian Prime Minister arrives in Zakarpattia
items.teaser: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar arrived in Ukraine's Zakarpattia (Transcarpathia) region on November 24 to meet with representatives of the local Hungarian community and separately with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: Zelensky confirms Ukrainian attack on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
items.teaser: While he defended Ukraine's right to strike the ship, he also acknowledged that the strike may have raised concerns among Ukraine's allies.

items.teaser: Poland's military authorized a shootdown of a Russian drone overnight, then held fire as it turned east.

items.title: Russians strike Dnipro: high-rise building damaged, four injured
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked Dnipro on 24 November, damaging a high-rise residential building and injuring at least four people, Governor Oleksandr Hanzha said.

items.title: Around 100 people on Kinburn Spit left without food or medicine, locals call for rescue mission
items.teaser: Around 100 people, most of whom are elderly, remain in three villages under Russian occupation on the Kinburn Spit. Ukraine's defence forces are considering a humanitarian mission to deliver aid.

items.title: Selenskyj bestätigt Angriff auf russischen Frachter im Finnischen Meerbusen

items.title: Latvian President sees potential turning point in Ukraine war next year
items.teaser: Russia's war against Ukraine could reach a turning point next year, potentially leading to Moscow's defeat as the Russian economy deteriorates and international pressure mounts.

items.title: Russians strike farm and grain warehouses in Odesa Oblast
items.teaser: Russian forces have attacked a farm and wheat warehouses in Odesa Oblast. No casualties have been reported.

items.title: UK defence secretary announces additional RapidRanger air defence systems for Ukraine during Kharkiv visit

items.title: Blocked Kerch Strait further traps Russia's Black Sea Fleet – Ukrainian Navy Spokesperson
items.teaser: The ability of the Russian Black Sea Fleet to maneuver and leave the Black Sea has been further restricted by the closure of the Kerch Strait.

items.title: Ukrainian parliament passes bill to strengthen asset disclosure rules for security officials
items.teaser: Most top SBU officials would also have to file asset declarations, and they would have to be public, according to the bill.

items.title: Sybiha, Tajani discuss security in Black and Mediterranean Seas following strikes on Russian vessels off Libya
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and his Italian counterpart Antonio Tajani discussed security challenges in the Black and the Mediterranean Seas, freedom of navigation, and diplomatic efforts to end Russia's war against Ukraine.

items.title: Selenskyj will sich an neu gewählten US-Kongress wenden, falls Trump keine Einigung mit Putin über Ende des Krieges erzielen kann
items.teaser: Der Präsident der Ukraine, Wolodymyr Selenskyj, plant, sich an den neu gewählten US- Kongress zu wenden, damit dieser den Druck auf Russland verstärkt, falls es Präsident Donald Trump nicht gelingt, den Kremlchef zu überzeugen, den Krieg bis zum Ende des Jahres zu beenden.

items.title: Zelensky confirms strike on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has confirmed that Ukraine struck the Russian cargo ship Sparta II with a drone in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday, November 21.

items.title: Moldova to bring its Russia, Belarus sanctions in line with EU as part of membership requirements
items.teaser: The EU has sanctioned over 4,700 individuals and entities as a result of Russia's war on Ukraine, and for a country to join the bloc, they need to implement every restriction as their own.

items.title: Ukraine to issue formal protest to IAEA over appointment of sanctioned Russian official as Grossi's deputy
items.teaser: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has instructed diplomats to issue a formal demarche to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and deliver a note of protest over the appointment of Alexei Ferapontov, deputy head of Russia's Federal Environmental, Industrial and Nuclear Supervision Service (Rostekhnadzor)

items.title: Is North Korea holding back on sending Russia more troops?
items.teaser: A North Korean troop buildup Ukraine warned about months ago has yet to materialize, even as strategic cooperation continues. Analysts say Pyongyang is balancing its ties with Moscow and Beijing.

items.title: Litauen hat der Ukraine seit 2022 Militärhilfe in Höhe von über einer Milliarde USD geleistet – Generalstab

items.title: Ukraine condemns decision to hand world nuclear body lead role to sanctioned Russian
items.teaser: Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha branded Ferapontov's appointment as IAEA deputy director general "absurd," and described him as "an accomplice in one of the greatest threats and gravest crimes against nuclear safety."

items.title: Zelensky to reach out to new US Congress if Trump fails to reach deal with Putin to end war
items.teaser: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky plans to reach out to the new Democrat-controlled U.S. Congress to intensify pressure on Russia if President Donald Trump fails to convince Vladimir Putin to end the war by the end of the year.

items.title: From Rostov to Perm, Ukraine’s drones attacked 15 Russian refineries in November
items.teaser: The latest strikes reached Perm and Rostov Oblast, after Russia's refining fell to about half of capacity in mid-November.

items.title: Norway in talks with Ukraine over attacks on Russian ships and regional stability
items.teaser: Norwegian Defense Minister Tore Sandvik said on Tuesday, November 24, that Oslo was holding talks with Ukraine on the “need for stability in our near areas.”

items.title: Verteidigungskräfte treffen angehäufte Lkw der Russen in Region Brjansk

items.title: Russian drone attack on Korosten railway station kills one, injury toll rises to three
items.teaser: Russian forces attacked a railway station in Korosten, Zhytomyr region, with a drone, killing one person and injuring three others.

items.title: Selenskyj: Letzte Nacht konzentrierten sich russische Angriffe auf Region Schytomyr, Schutz hat funktioniert
items.teaser: Präsident Wolodymyr Selenskyj erklärte auf Facebook, dass die Russen letzte Nacht ihre Angriffe auf die Region Schytomyr, auf die Infrastruktur für die Stromverteilung und -übertragung, konzentriert hätten. Der Schutz habe funktioniert, so Selenskyj.

items.title: Hospital damaged in Russian attack on Odesa
items.teaser: A municipal hospital building in Odesa was damaged in a Russian attack on the afternoon of November 24.

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit Russian military truck concentration area in Bryansk region
items.teaser: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck an area where Russian military trucks were concentrated near Berestok in Russia's Bryansk region on November 23 and overnight into November 24.

items.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine needs more F-16s and will need more Gripens to counter Russia’s jet-powered Shaheds
items.teaser: Kyiv expects the Swedish jets from January and has asked allies for 40 more fighters.

items.title: Bombed factories, billion-dollar opportunity: Why German companies keep investing in Ukraine
items.teaser: German companies remain committed to Ukraine despite million-dollar losses, an unreliable energy supply and a shortage of skilled workers. They are betting on new markets and long-term growth.

items.title: Ukraine has right to strike military targets in Russia, but war must not spread to Baltic Sea – Pistorius
items.teaser: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius has reaffirmed Ukraine's right to strike military targets on Russian territory, while warning against the war spreading to the Baltic Sea and stressing Ukraine's particular responsibility in this regard.

items.title: Ungarns Ministerpräsident Peter Magyar reist erstmals in die Ukraine
items.teaser: Der ungarische Ministerpräsident Peter Magyar ist am 24. November zu seinem ersten Besuch in die Ukraine als Regierungschef nach Transkarpatien gereist.

items.title: Bombed factories, billion-dollar opportunity: Why German companies are staying in Ukraine
items.teaser: German companies remain committed to Ukraine despite million-dollar losses, an unreliable energy supply and a shortage of skilled workers. They are betting on new markets and long-term growth.

items.title: German cleaning products banned from export to Russia found on Russian marketplaces Ozon and Wildberries, rights group Libereco reports
items.teaser: The maker of Frosch cleaners says it stopped all deliveries of its products to Russia in February 2022.
